new_theorems.statement: For one original-coordinate hub h and leaf block A_II=D+sum_{k=1}^r lambda_k v_k v_k^T, define rho_i=((v_k)_i,A_ih) and G=sum rho_i rho_i^T. If G>0 and max_i rho_i^T G^{-1}rho_i<=1/2, with arbitrary remaining blocks and affine terms, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= C_r [det(G) prod|lambda_k|]^(-1/(r+2)), C_r=4(r+2)/r*2^(-2/(r+2)).
new_theorems.source: direct corollary of source Theorem H at math-open-problems@e5f71d79eff325201dd0274053d20268ce65b837

new_theorems.statement: For r=1, c=A_Ih and A_II=D+lambda vv^T, ||p_Q||_infinity <=3*2^(4/3)[|lambda|(||v||^2||c||^2-<v,c>^2)]^(-1/3), provided the mixed-frame leverage is <=1/2.

target_valid_stress_family.form: Q_m=2 X_h<c,X_I>+<v,X_I>^2 with c flat and v balanced-sign flat on an even size-m leaf bank, c perpendicular v
target_valid_stress_family.physical_2x2_determinants: 0 on leaf-leaf pairs and -1/m on hub-leaf pairs
target_valid_stress_family.N3_status: for every fixed tau>0, sufficiently large m is strictly in the no-pivot class

degeneracy_control.meaning: wedge-degenerate active core may retain the rank-two logarithmic obstruction; not a QFORM counterexample
